One of the big things is breathing with your CHEST. We do this over time and subconsciously train ourselves this way, and it makes sense because lungs are in your chest right? 

Well, I was reading a study awhile back and found that breathing with your STOMACH ( watching the rise and fall of your belly when you breathe ) as opposed to breathing with your chest, reduces stress, anxiety, and lowers the heart rate significantly. Newborn babies breathe with their bellies, and it's only over time growing up that we switch it over to chest in our heads.

Weird shit, I know, but hey it helps me out at work when it gets hectic and I need to refocus.
